newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae Industria up on capital call.
newsitem.headline: Sonae Industria up on capital call.

text.p: Sonae Industria stock jumped at the start nearly eight percent after the Portuguese wood products group announced a capital call at a price significantly above current market levels.
The capital call, to take place between June 20 and July 4, was priced at 1,700 escudos per share against the stock's close on Tuesday at 1,482.
But several traders said that the stock was unlikely to climb further on Wednesday because of the time still to go before the capital call would be launched.
"I think the stock will probably not go much beyond 1,600 escudos for now," said one trader.
Shares in Inparsa, Sonae's parent, were also gaining nearly three percent at 1,496 escudos.

Traders said that the decision to set the capital call price significantly above the market indicated that the main shareholder was looking to boost its grip over the wood group. Inparsa-SGPS has 63 percent of Sonae Industria.
